title: Birbal and the Shorter Line
moral: You can change perspective without changing reality.

scenes.summary: Akbar draws a line and gives a challenge.
scenes.text: One day, Emperor Akbar drew a long line on the floor and challenged everyone to make it shorter without touching it.
scenes.image_prompt: king drawing line on floor in royal court, colorful cartoon style

scenes.summary: People try but fail to solve the challenge.
scenes.text: Many courtiers tried to make the line shorter, but no one could solve the problem.
scenes.image_prompt: people confused looking at line in court, cartoon scene

scenes.summary: Birbal steps forward to solve the challenge.
scenes.text: Birbal came forward calmly and thought of a simple idea.
scenes.image_prompt: birbal stepping forward confidently in court, cartoon illustration

scenes.summary: Birbal draws a longer line beside the first.
scenes.text: Birbal drew a longer line next to the first one without touching the original line.
scenes.image_prompt: birbal drawing longer line next to shorter line, bright cartoon

scenes.summary: The original line appears shorter and Akbar praises Birbal.
scenes.text: Now the first line looked shorter. Akbar praised Birbal for his clever thinking. You can change perspective without changing reality.
scenes.image_prompt: king smiling and praising birbal in court, cheerful cartoon

story: One day, Emperor Akbar drew a long line on the floor and challenged everyone to make it shorter without touching it. Many people tried but failed. Then Birbal came forward and drew a longer line next to it. Now, the original line looked shorter. Akbar smiled and praised Birbal for his clever idea.
